extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners; patent practitioners (attorneys, agents) and applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) Eighth Edition, Revision 7, listing chapters and appendices that define USPTO examination procedures and substantive patent practice topics. Used as the top-level map to detailed procedural and substantive guidance for patent examination and prosecution in the U.S.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blue Pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Blue Pages (section of the MPEP included in Revision 7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains the Blue Pages of the MPEP; E8r7 provides PDF and HTML files for download.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title Page
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP title information; accessible as PDF and HTML in E8r7.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreword
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefatory material for the MPEP edition; available in E8r7 PDF/HTML.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of Contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of Contents (TOC) for the MPEP E8r7.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top-level navigation to all chapters and appendices in the E8r7 release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introductory material to the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure; available in E8r7 PDF/HTML.

rubrics_metrics.name: 100 Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 0100 — Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers secrecy orders, national security considerations, access to files, and foreign filing issues as applicable to patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 200 Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 0200 — Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses types of applications, cross-noting procedures, and application status handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: 300 Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on ownership issues, assignments, and related recordation considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 400 Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 0400 — Representative of Inventor or Owner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers representation before the Office, power of attorney, and agent/attorney responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 500 Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 0500 — Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for receipt, processing, and handling of correspondence and papers filed with the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: 600 Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 0600 — Parts, Form, and Content of Application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for application parts, formalities, and substantive content (specification, claims, drawings, oath/declaration).

rubrics_metrics.name: 700 Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and standards for substantive examination of patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 800 Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 0800 — Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on restriction practice, election of species, and double patenting issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: 900 Prior Art, Classification, and Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 0900 — Prior Art, Classification, and Search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and procedures for prior art searching, classification of applications, and related search practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1000 Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 1000 — Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains authorities and decision-making responsibilities of various USPTO officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1100 Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 1100 — Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures related to SIR and pre-grant publication of applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1200 Appeal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for appeals from examiner decisions, briefing, oral hearings, and related processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1300 Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and procedures for allowance, issue, and patent grant formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1400 Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for correcting errors in patents (reissue, reexamination-related corrections, certificates of correction).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1500 Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practice and examination standards specific to design patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1600 Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practice and examination standards specific to plant patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1700 Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Various topics not covered in other chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1800 Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on PCT procedures and national entry under the Patent Cooperation Treaty.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1900 Protest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for filing and processing protests against patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2000 Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and duties regarding disclosure of material information (duty of candor/inequitable conduct issues).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2100 Patentability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substantive patentability standards (novelty, nonobviousness, statutory subject matter, utility) and related examination guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2200 Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 2200 — Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for citing prior art and initiating/processing ex parte reexamination proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300 Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and procedures related to interference proceedings (pre-AIA first-to-invent contests).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400 Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialized examination guidance for biotechnology-related subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500 Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and procedures for payment and processing of maintenance fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2600 Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for inter partes reexamination (optional post-grant review of patents).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2700 Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and calculations for patent term, term adjustments, and extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix I — Partial List of Trademarks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix listing trademarks referenced in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix II — List of Decisions Cited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A compiled list of judicial and Board decisions cited in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidated patent laws as provided in the MPEP (see Appendix L or Consolidated Patent Laws).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidated patent rules (see Appendix R or Consolidated Patent Rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text and guidance related to the PCT included as an appendix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix AI — Administrative Instructions Under The PCT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative instructions applicable under the PCT included in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text and guidance related to the Paris Convention included as an appendix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index - Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject matter index for navigating the MPEP; available in PDF and HTML in E8r7.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP E8r7 availability and formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of the MPEP E8r7 in PDF and HTML formats, zipped downloads for chapters and appendices, and information on obtaining paper/DVD-ROM copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides download links and ordering information (DVD-ROM, paper). Notes that some content may require Adobe Acrobat Reader or ZIP capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revision history and scope of E8r7
rubrics_metrics.description: Revision 7 (July 2008) updated Blue Pages; Title Page; Chapters 600, 1400, 1800, 2200, 2500, and 2600; Appendices II, R, T, and AI; and the Index.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains which documents were updated in Revision 7 and points to E8r7 PDF/HTML files.
